comment: BLOCKED: this independent raven variation reaches polyself.c:break_armor, which drops the cloak and quarterstaff onto the wished pit through do.c:dropx and do.c:flooreffects. The equivalent C setup reaches the Flying escape only after its equipment-drop messages are dismissed; this recipe is retained as a coverage gap, not passing evidence.
